industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: PTC India Limited
summary: PTC India Limited, along with its subsidiary entities, is a prominent player in the electricity trading market, operating across India, Nepal, Bhutan, and Bangladesh. The company facilitates the buying and selling of power through various arrangements, including short-term, medium-term, and long-term contracts, as well as cross-border energy exchanges. Beyond its core trading activities, PTC India extends financial services to the energy value chain, supporting power generation, transmission, distribution, fuel resource development, and associated infrastructure projects. It also offers specialized consultancy and advisory expertise. Its customer base is diverse, encompassing public utilities, power producers, and a range of industrial and commercial enterprises. Established in 1999, originally as Power Trading Corporation of India Ltd before adopting its current name, PTC India Limited maintains its main office in New Delhi, India.
